sources.title: Burn-out an "occupational phenomenon": International Classification of Diseases
Understanding the burnout experience: Recent research and its implications for psychiatry

concepts.definition: An occupational syndrome from chronic workplace stress that has not been successfully managed, with exhaustion, distance and reduced efficacy.
The ability to recover from setbacks and adapt.

questions.q: What are the three dimensions of burnout in ICD-11?
questions.a: Energy depletion or exhaustion, mental distance or cynicism about the job, and reduced professional efficacy.

questions.q: Why is individual resilience advice incomplete?
questions.a: It leaves the job design unchanged and puts the burden on the person.
